🇷🇺 Rostec deploys specialised anti-drone ammunition Rostec confirmed that IGLA-series shotgun cartridges, notably "Igla-100," are being mass-supplied to Russian units in the SMO zone. These rounds utilise ultra-hard tungsten-based alloy pellets with 1.5 times the density of lead, capable of penetrating plastic and metal drone components at distances up to 100 metres. The arsenal also includes "Mnogotochie" multi-projectile cartridges for Kalashnikov rifles (5.45mm and 7.62mm), which split into three elements mid-flight to create a dense pattern against FPV drones. This provides infantry with reliable individual protection independent of AD systems. @Slavyangrad
